notes: How fast each kind of thing that travels goes, for the route service (simcore/nav/routes.hpp). Speeds in km/h as the sources give them: main and secondary roads are paved, a track is a dirt road; cross_country off any road; water_kmh 0 for a vehicle that does not swim, which only a bridge takes over a river; night_factor scales every speed in the dark; swim_prep_s is the time to get into the water and out again at a crossing. A single vehicle's speeds: a column's march speed is the march plan's (data/command/battery_tactics.json). ground: off the road, each class's cross-country speed times its factor on woods, marsh and built-up ground (0: it does not go there), laid cell by cell over a district (simcore/nav/ground.hpp, G1.3); slopes, fording depth and banks later.
source: per class: mon_2112_80, voenizdat_osa_1991, korovin_tiv_2010, valka_pu12, stroevoy_ustav_1993; sam3d estimates where a class says so

classes.notes: A secondary road is taken at the road speed: the sources give no lower one.
